d: Iran has unveiled a new underground drone factory displaying hundreds of drones, including the Arash-3, which Tehran claims will be more lethal than its predecessor, the Arash-2. The development follows US President Donald Trump’s claim that Iran’s military had been severely damaged. Meanwhile, Israeli forces face renewed tensions after a shooting near Hebron in the occupied West Bank killed two Israeli soldiers and injured three others. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has ordered a complete lockdown of the West Bank, while the Israeli military launches a new operation. Firstpost…
